payload.core_mechanism_summary: Direct construction: if n==1 output -1, else output n, n+1, n*(n+1) as the three distinct denominators that satisfy the fraction sum identity 1/n + 1/(n+1) + 1/(n(n+1)) = 2/n.
payload.rationale: The solution does not perform any search or dynamic programming; it exploits a mathematical identity to construct the answer directly. No backtracking, branch-and-bound, or enumeration is present. Hence it is a mismatch for the provided candidate families (all complete_search or dp).
